vcp: Highs hold the pivot zone (0.85-1.05x first high)
cup_handle: Prior uptrend >= 20% into the left rim
Rounded bottom (>= 20% of the cup in its lower third)
Handle <= 15% and <= half the cup depth
Handle in the upper half of the cup
breakout_52w: Fresh (no 52-week high in the prior 20 bars)
Out of a base (>= 10% pullback in the last 60 bars)
flat_base: Base high set in the first half (sideways since)
Not broken out yet (close below the base high)
Close within 5% of the base high
high_tight_flag: Flag holds within 25% of the high
No new high in the flag (<= +2%)
